description: Open-source MCP servers for AutonomousSDLC. Cursor uses .cursor/mcp.json; Strands agents load the same servers programmatically.

env.note: Auth via mcp-remote OAuth (~/.mcp-auth). Do not use Jira ATATT API tokens.

aws-diagram.name: AWS Diagram (diagrams package)
aws-diagram.notes: Requires Graphviz (dot on PATH). Use 1.0.23+ on Windows (1.0.8 SIGALRM fails). PNGs go to ARCHITECT_DIAGRAM_OUTPUT_DIR (default docs/diagrams). Relative filenames land in generated-diagrams/ — architect agent uses absolute diagramOutputFile to avoid that.

aws-postgres.name: AWS Labs Postgres MCP

env.AWS_PROFILE: AWS profile with access to Aurora/RDS

aws-postgres.notes: Supports RDS API and wire-protocol based connections. Configure DB endpoint or cluster ARN at runtime as needed.

MongoDB.name: MongoDB MCP

env.MDB_MCP_API_CLIENT_ID: Atlas service account client id (Option B)
env.MDB_MCP_API_CLIENT_SECRET: Atlas service account client secret (Option B)

MongoDB.notes: Use either connection-string auth or Atlas service-account auth; see MongoDB MCP prerequisites.

Firecrawl.name: Firecrawl MCP

env.FIRECRAWL_API_KEY: API key from firecrawl.dev (Firecrawl_API_Key in .env.local also accepted)

Firecrawl.notes: Scrape, crawl, map, and search for web-crawler-agent. Runs after architect-agent when requirements mention URL ingestion.

GitLab.name: GitLab MCP

env.GITLAB_TOKEN: GitLab PAT with api scope (or GITLAB_PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN in .env)
env.GITLAB_PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN: Used by gitlab-agent CLI; wrapper maps to GITLAB_TOKEN for MCP

GitLab.notes: jmrplens uses REST API v4 on GitLab Free. Native https://host/api/v4/mcp needs Duo Premium. Pipeline publish: gitlab-agent via jmrplens MCP. Binary: bin/gitlab-mcp-server.exe via install script.

Playwright.name: Playwright

env.QA_ENABLE_PLAYWRIGHT_MCP: Set 0 to skip Playwright in qa-agent

Playwright.notes: Browser E2E for apps with UI/Streamlit. Requires Node 20+; browsers download on first use.

postman.name: Postman

env.QA_ENABLE_POSTMAN_MCP: Set 0 to skip Postman in qa-agent

postman.notes: API integration testing via runCollection. Strands agents use streamable HTTP with Bearer token.
